data.name: Minds Define Us
data.detailed_description:
Minds Define Us is a top-down extraction action-adventure game that blends life on the road, camper van living, and a story-driven experience. Start up your camper van and set out on a journey into the unknown.

Story

Overview Five years ago, everything outside a ten-odd-kilometer radius of Zhuyuan City was sealed off overnight. The official explanation was a radiation leak, but nobody bought it. You wake up deep inside a forbidden, perilous exclusion zone inside a modified camper van with absolutely no memory, save for a video message you left for yourself: Keep the plan moving. Get to Zhuyuan. By day, venture out to battle rogue machines and salvage spare parts. By night, repair your van and share a warm meal with those willing to stay by your side. Step by step, you will uncover the hidden truths of this region, untangle the schemes of various factions, forge deep bonds with your companions, and bring everything to a definitive end at your final destination.

Key Features

  • Top-Down Action
    Seamlessly switch between melee and ranged combat, and master the timing of perfect dodges to strike back at your enemies.

  • Exploration & Salvage
    Scavenge for resources across multiple open levels to power up, while uncovering the forgotten stories of what once was.

  • Camp Management
    Maintain your own mobile mini-farm, and cook delicious meals to share with your companions. Personalize your camp with unique decorations to make it your own.

  • Story & Characters
    Embark on a mystery-filled road trip adventure. Meet and bond with a diverse cast of characters along the way, with opportunities to develop romantic relationships with some of them.

data.short_description: Fire up your camper van and hit the road! Minds Define Us is a story-driven, top-down extraction action-adventure. Scavenge supplies in robot-infested zones, safely extract, meet companions, share home-cooked campfire meals, and upgrade your gear as you uncover the truth behind the distant rumble.
